lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters organized in a grid-like matrix of vertical columns containing 4 to 6 units, positioned posterior to the branchial region and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible lattice pattern along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank; the primary medial ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with a highlight-to-shadow transition extending toward the caudal peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and trailing the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
